text:
Ivy Chen: Quick spot from the usability pass  the in-app help drawer and docs site disagree on a label used in the Runtime card. Console says 'Dedicated pool' while docs call it 'Reserved slots'. Want to align before next release.

Marco Silva: Do we have analytics showing which term users search for? could influence the canonical choice.

Tara Singh: Search logs show both terms but 'Reserved slots' has slightly higher conversion in our onboarding funnel. My vote is canonicalize docs to 'Reserved slots' and use a transitional Console label.

Omar Haddad: Dev note: friendly transitional label idea: "Dedicated pool (Reserved slots)". Also we should make the drawer's 'Learn more' link explicitly target the docs canonical path with UTM param so analytics are clear: `/docs/reserved-slots?src=drawer`.

Ivy Chen: Good call on UTM. Also the drawer currently links to `/help/start` which 404ed in last scan. We need a redirect or update.

Link Auditor Bot: link-scan: /help/start -> 404 (scan 2026-02-14). recommended action: add redirect to /docs/reserved-slots.

Marco Silva: Can the internal link resolver support alias arrays? If not, we'll add a redirect entry in the docs static redirects table. Also consider adding a short glossary entry and a single-sentence blurb in the drawer to avoid bouncing users.

Tara Singh: UX nits: the drawer's title type is 600/16 while Console titles are 700/18. Prefer matching Console tokens. Also the close icon lacks context for screen readers; it currently uses title="Close". Change to aria-label="Close help (in-app)" and ensure focus returns to the opener button.

Omar Haddad: Focus-trap check: the drawer component already traps focus but we pass a different return-ref name from Console. I'll standardize the prop and add an e2e that verifies focus-return on close.

Ivy Chen: Accessibility addendum: when the drawer displays streaming examples, please add aria-live="polite" on the stream container so assistive tech announces updates.

Link Auditor Bot: a11y-scan: missing aria-live on dynamic content in drawer.

Marco Silva: Small styling ask: visited link color in the drawer is currently low-contrast. Use the Console token `--link-visited` which meets 4.5:1. Also add an underline focus style for keyboard users.

Tara Singh: I'll update the mock to 700/18 title, drawer blurb copy, and the aria-labels. Ivy can you draft the copy for the transitional label and the one-line blurb?

Ivy Chen: Draft copy: "Reserved slots (shown as Dedicated pool in Console) 1 Learn more about Reserved slots and capacity planning." I'll post it to the design doc.

Omar Haddad: Action items: Marco 1 add redirect /help/start -> /docs/reserved-slots and confirm alias support; Tara 1 update mock and make ARIA changes; Ivy 1 add blurb and update design doc; I'll consolidate props and add e2e.

Link Auditor Bot: Created ticket #5012: "Redirect /help/start -> /docs/reserved-slots; drawer a11y + visited link contrast; analytics UTM for drawer links."

Ivy Chen: Thanks everyone  small harmonization but will reduce confusion for new users and help our analytics be cleaner. We'll track progress in #product and link the PRs here. :sparkles:
